title: Book Three · Chapter 81: Five Quiet Minutes
story:
The next week, Leo's thirteenth reply arrives.

He has read the news about Anna. His first question makes Ronan laugh.

Does Kai still get the ball? Or does the window have it now?

Then Leo writes that he is glad. He hopes to visit again in the summer, but his family has not chosen the dates.

Ronan takes the letter to his shelf. He will answer after he knows his own holiday dates.

On Saturday afternoon, he meets Anna near the hall. She has a new drawing to finish before Monday.

“Five minutes?” she asks.

“I can wait.”

They sit on the low wall. Anna opens the notebook and checks the doorway against her lines.

Ronan watches for a little while. Then a boy runs past with a long stick, and he turns to tell her about Kai's cousin.

Anna smiles, but her pencil stops.

He tells another part of the story. She looks at the drawing again, then back at him.

“I need five quiet minutes,” she says.

Ronan stops. “Oh.”

“Just this last part.”

He looks down the road.

For a moment, his face feels hot.

“I thought we were going to walk.”

“We are. After this.”

Anna puts the pencil down and turns toward him.

“You don't have to watch the whole drawing.”

“I wanted to talk to you.”

“I want that too. I also need to finish the doorway.”

They look at each other. Then Ronan nods.

“I can look at the shops. I'll come back.”

“Thank you.”

He walks as far as the corner. There is a new display of cups in one window. He looks at the blue ones, then the brown ones.

By the time he returns, Anna is closing her notebook.

“Done?”

“Done.”

She stands and puts the bag over her shoulder. Then she takes his hand.

The drawing is beside her notes about study in another city. She has more than one place on her list.

“Now tell me about the car.”

Ronan starts the story again. This time, her pencil stays in the bag. They walk slowly, and she laughs at the right part.

Near the crossing, he tells her about Leo's letter.

“Another visit?”

“He hopes so. No dates yet.”

“Tell me when he knows. I have a few things I want to do in the holiday too.”

Ronan nods.

At the corner, Anna squeezes his hand before they separate. He goes home with the story finished and the sound of her laugh still clear in his head.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

quiet＝安静的；display＝陈列；doorway＝门口、门洞；return＝回来。

## 理解问题

1. Anna为什么需要安静几分钟？这是否表示她不想和Ronan说话？
2. 两人怎样调整这段下午时间？Leo的暑假日期是否已经确定？

## 读句子

**She stands and puts the bag over her shoulder.**

拆开看：She / stands / and puts the bag over her shoulder.

她／站起来／把包背到肩上。
